CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION jgap_private.prevent_bookkeeping_relink()

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_free_eligibility_review()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='INSERT' then
  insert into public.free_eligibility_review_audit(user_id,company_id,old_status,new_status)
  values(new.user_id,new.company_id,null,new.status);
 elsif old.status is distinct from new.status then
  insert into public.free_eligibility_review_audit(user_id,company_id,old_status,new_status)
  values(new.user_id,new.company_id,old.status,new.status);
 end if;
 return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_subscription_changes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.plan is distinct from new.plan or old.billing_status is distinct from new.billing_status then
  insert into public.subscription_change_audit(company_id,old_plan,new_plan,old_billing_status,new_billing_status)
  values(new.company_id,old.plan,new.plan,old.billing_status,new.billing_status);
 end if;
 return new;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_my_companies()
 RETURNS TABLE(company_id uuid, company_name text, member_role text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select cm.company_id, c.name, cm.role
  from public.company_members as cm
  join public.companies as c on c.id = cm.company_id
  where cm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  order by cm.created_at, cm.company_id;
$function$

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status <> 'completed'::text) OR (completed_on IS NOT NULL)) AND ((completed_on IS NULL) OR (completed_on >= opened_on))))

constraints.name: property_repairs_company_id_deal_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, deal_id) REFERENCES deals(company_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: property_repairs_title_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) <= 150)))

relations.name: property_tasks
indexes: CREATE INDEX property_tasks_scope_idx ON public.property_tasks USING btree (company_id, deal_id, id)
CREATE INDEX property_tasks_date_idx ON public.property_tasks USING btree (company_id, deal_id, due_on)

policies.name: activity_insert
policies.check: (can_access_passport(company_id) AND (jgap_private.member_role(company_id) = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'editor'::text])))

policies.name: activity_update
policies.check: (can_access_passport(company_id) AND (jgap_private.member_role(company_id) = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'editor'::text])))
